summary: Clearwater National Forest cabin site 26 miles west of Powell: log cabins listed for 1910 and 1912, ruins per two sites. Little else in the sources.

facts.design: Log cabin (1910; a second log cabin in 1912)
facts.status_note: Two log cabins (1910, 1912); the two sites with a history list ruins. One labels the site Hike-In (access type; no statement on public access). No source describes the site today.

events.note: Log cabin. One site asks, with a question mark, whether it burned in the 1910 Idaho fire; unconfirmed
Second log cabin; later listed as ruins
Single staff entry: John Davis, citing the Kellogg Evening News

evidence.supports: question whether the 1910 cabin burned in the 1910 Idaho fire
the Latah County tower is a separate site
Latah County tower is on the cabin rental program
evidence.quote: it is on the Clearwater National Forest cabin rental program

corrections.why: Both Forest Lookouts and firelookout.com place the site in Idaho County; the record's county value is the state name.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no description of the site after 1912, and one staff line. The NHLR Bald Mountain Lookout (Latah County, 47.03, -116.57; record us-id-bald-mountain-3) is a different tower: NHLR gives its first cabin as 1913, which does not match the 1910/1912 cabins here, and no source links the two. Record location 46.45455, -115.24262 was not checked against the 26-miles-west-of-Powell description. Do not publish a visit suggestion; none is supported.
